children: Roundtable forecasts $102.1 million in 2027 revenue and expects annualized Adjusted EBITDA‑positive operations in 2027.
Company files Form 8-K disclosing a 2027 operating forecast of $102.1M revenue and $13.2M adjusted EBITDA.
Forecast assumes 104 enterprise media customers and ~99.8M monthly unique users for full-year 2027.
Gross margin projected ~41% with FY gross profit of $42.0M and operating expenses of $28.8M.
Projection is pro forma for the Paradium.AI partnership and requires successful closure and financing of the PAAI transaction.
Notes that forward-looking forecasts depend on risks including Nasdaq listing, capital availability and business integration.
